slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
noticeably smarter

stargazing

spend 10 minutes on a clear night learning to find three constellations. once you can read the sky, you feel how big the world is and how much is still left to learn.

naming trees

learn the names of the trees on your daily walk, one a week. a street you've walked a hundred times becomes a new place when you know what you're looking at.

kitchen science

find out why one thing happens in your kitchen every week: why bread rises, why onions make you cry. science is everywhere, and the curious ones notice it first.

the daily wonder

spend 5 minutes a day learning one thing about how the world works: volcanoes, the deep sea, the human heart. curiosity is a muscle, and it grows every time you feed it.
slides.texte_sophia:
the daily wonder

i used to know so little about how the world works. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: volcanoes, the deep sea. curiosity grows every time you feed it.

slides.texte_overlay:
documentaries over reels

swap one evening of short videos a week for one good documentary. one hour on a single subject stays in your head far longer than a hundred clips about nothing.
